label: HEURISTIC RANKING - NOT A HUMAN OR LLM JUDGMENT. Candidates only: a person reviews them. Every item was judged by keyword and metadata rules on its title, channel type, duration and age (judged_by: heuristic); nobody watched the videos.
how: docs/design/media-ranking.md. Run once for the whole state (statewide_top, rank) and once per diocese (candidates; the cap of 2 items per channel per week and the rotation apply inside that diocese).
caveats: Dates are approximate ('3 weeks ago'), so the freshness and per-week cap are approximate.
The heuristic reads titles only; a substantive video with a plain title can land as 'other'.
Routine Mass streams and school-internal videos are kept off the list by rule (excluded_by_reason).
Channels are catalogued after an ownership check (verified or probable); see channels.json.
